{{Top}}
'''Hydro-glycolic fuel cells''' were [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] that appear to have run on [[Water/Legends|water]] and [[glycol]]. They were used in [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series]] droids.

They were manufactured by [[Kevdan Aerosystems/Legends|Kevdan Aerosystems]].
